critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in this iteration: AdminScreen had 2 React hooks violations: (1) router.back() called synchronously in render causing 'navigate before mounting Root Layout' crash on direct URL access. (2) useCallback and useFocusEffect defined after conditional return violating Rules of Hooks. Fix: moved all hooks before conditionals, used useEffect for redirect.

Alert.alert for delete confirmation uses browser native window.confirm on web - this is correct behavior but means automated E2E testing needs page.on('dialog') event handler setup properly before the click.
The /api/admin/payments endpoint exists and returns [] when no payments (frontend correctly handles this with .catch(() => []) fallback).
useFocusEffect should only call load() when user is admin (added check), otherwise it would make API calls for non-admin users.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Dashboard is fully functional after fixing the React hooks violation bug in app/admin/index.tsx. Backend: all 27 admin API tests pass (100%). Frontend flows verified: stats tab (correct data), rules tab (create/edit/toggle/list), plans tab (create/edit/toggle/list), payments tab (empty state), profile→admin navigation, back button to profile. Delete functionality works via backend API. The Alert.alert dialog in Playwright needs page.on('dialog', handler) setup BEFORE the delete button click (not after). Key fix: all React hooks must be before conditional returns in AdminScreen.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: AdminScreen originally called router.back() synchronously in the component render body (line 513: 'if (user?.role !== 'admin') { router.back(); return null; }'). This caused 2 issues: (1) On direct URL navigation to /admin, Expo Router's Root Layout has not mounted yet, so router.back() throws 'Attempted to navigate before mounting the Root Layout component'. (2) useCallback and useFocusEffect hooks were defined AFTER this conditional return, violating React Rules of Hooks (hooks must always be called in the same order). Fix applied: moved all hooks (useCallback for load, useFocusEffect) before any conditional returns. Added useEffect for the router.back() redirect that only fires after authLoading is false. Added loading spinner for the authLoading state.
